decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1.  No entertainment, religious or cultural activities shall take place anywhere on the site except within the function room and club bar lounge.

2.   The use of the club bar lounge shall not commence until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against internally generated noise has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accrdance with any approval granted.

3.  Before the use of the functiion hall and club bar lounge commences, details of a noise limiting device shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and shall be installed in accordance with any approval granted.

Informative
The applicant is reminded that conditions attached to the original consent regarding details of the arrangements for storing of refuse and waste, details of external lighting, details of ventilation, details of a scheme for control of fumes and odours including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and details of disabled access have yet to be submited and must be agreed with the Local Planning Authority and installed prior to the commencement of the use.
description: Variation of condition 5 (no entertainment, religious or cultural activities) of approved permission ref no 01254/210/P1 dated 17/11/1998
